title: Crash (SIGSEGV) on right-click in -webkit-app-region: drag on macOS 26
body:
## Description Right-clicking on an element with `-webkit-app-region: drag` in a `titleBarStyle: 'hidden'` window causes a SIGSEGV crash (null pointer dereference at address 0x0) on macOS 26 (Tahoe, build 25C56). The crash occurs inside `[ElectronNSWindow sendEvent:]` → `[super sendEvent:]` when processing `NSEventTypeRightMouseDown`. The `sendEvent` override temporarily disables draggable regions via `WebContents::SetDisableDraggableRegions(true)`, which makes `draggable_region()` return `nullptr`. Something in Chromium's event routing then dereferences this null pointer. ## Versions - Tested on Electron 42.0.1 (Chromium 148) and 43.0.0-alpha.1 (Chromium 149) — both crash - Electron 41.3.0 does NOT crash - macOS 26.2 (25C56), Apple Silicon (Mac16,6) ## Minimal Reproduction ```js // main.js const { app, BrowserWindow } = require('electron'); app.whenReady().then(() => { const win = new BrowserWindow({ width: 800, height: 600, titleBarStyle: 'hidden', webPreferences: { nodeIntegration: false, contextIsolation: true } }); win.loadURL('data:text/html,
RIGHT CLICK HERE TO CRASH
Content area
'); }); ``` ```json // package.json {"name":"crash-test","version":"1.0.0","main":"main.js"} ``` Steps: 1. Run `npx electron .` 2. Right-click on the gray "RIGHT CLICK HERE TO CRASH" bar 3. App crashes with SIGSEGV ## Crash Report (key frames) ``` Exception Type: EXC_BAD_ACCESS (SIGSEGV) Exception Subtype: KERN_INVALID_ADDRESS at 0x0000000000000000 Thread 0 Crashed:: CrBrowserMain 0 Electron Framework 0x114526b88 ... 7 AppKit 0x190e3c860 -[NSApplication(NSEventRouting) sendEvent:] + 1276 8 Electron Framework 0x10e92a9bc ``` ## Analysis The crash path is in `shell/browser/ui/cocoa/electron_ns_window.mm` line 224-243. The `sendEvent:` override calls `SetDisableDraggableRegions(true)` before `[super sendEvent:event]`. This makes `WebContents::draggable_region()` return `nullptr` (line 2191 of `electron_api_web_contents.cc`). On macOS 26, the Chromium event handler inside `[super sendEvent:]` appears to dereference this null pointer. This did NOT crash on macOS 15 or Electron 41. ## Expected Behavior Right-clicking on a drag region should show a context menu (or do nothing), not crash.
